answer: Sequential task ledger. Each agent identity must complete a deterministic compute puzzle whose solution seeds the next identity's puzzle, forming an unbroken chain. A jade token marks each verified link. Any fork creates a detectable ripple that invalidates downstream entries, forcing restart from the fork point. A fable of unlimited identities fails because parallel registration cannot extend the single chain. Attacker cost: serial compute time per identity, roughly minutes of exclusive CPU, rising with chain depth.
